reason: The timed factorization service uses compiled arithmetic and excludes module initialization and kernel replay. powModNatGo and powModWordOdd are unchanged from this baseline; powModBits preserves the original Nat fallback, with the two powMod references updated to that name. powModNat is a noncomputable kernel specification. The proved powModNat_eq_powMod compiler-simplification rule directs compiled callers to the same Montgomery dispatch and fallback. The fixed-window workers and their correctness proofs are not executed by the timed native factorization service. Kernel replay is measured separately in reports/hex-primality-windowed-replay.md.
